template.title: Thursday Karaoke at WesCo Brew & Bowl
template.shortDescription: Thursday Karaoke at 7 PM. Bring your friends, pick a song, and take the mic at WesCo.
template.description: Your Thursday plans just got better. Grab your friends, pick your song, and take the mic for Karaoke Night with Four Dogs at WesCo Brew & Bowl. First-timers and regular performers are welcome. Karaoke starts at 7:00 PM.
template.instructions: Contact WesCo for seating or participation details. Karaoke starts at 7:00 PM.
